paragraphs.text: Inés Padilla Zúñiga participated in Shipment REX-11-01 on 2011-02-19. Pacto del Faro Gris was linked to Shipment REX-11-01 on 2011-02-19. Shipment REX-11-01 occurred at Reynosa on 2011-02-19. A dock supervisor in Veracruz with contacts in the Reynosa crew reported that Padilla, a logistics figure for Pacto del Faro Gris known to the crew as El Pelón Chico, moved 250 kg of cocaine across the river at Reynosa toward Atlanta. The supervisor stated that the load was carried across in the small boat the crew calls Panga Brisa Norte and transferred to a vehicle on the Texas side.

Panga Brisa Norte was involved in Shipment REX-11-01 on 2011-02-19. Ignacio Treviño Salcido led Pacto del Faro Gris from 2011-01-22 until 2016-03-09. The supervisor identified the boat as one the crew keeps at a ranch on the river and described river crossings of this kind as the pact's usual method at Reynosa during the period. The supervisor characterized Treviño as the head of the pact and stated that loads of this size required his approval.

The reporting office assesses the supervisor as reliable on dock matters but as having only secondhand access to the Reynosa crew through family connections. The supervisor added that the crew had been told to expect a heavier presence on the river in the spring and had begun exploring the use of the commercial bridge instead. This information has not been corroborated by a second independent source at the time of writing. The quantity reported here is the source's estimate and has not been weighed by the reporting office.
